title: ohal extraction plan
description: Schema for atomic, incremental plans that extract reference-manual content into ohal family specifications.

step-id.description: Identifier for a plan step. Base steps: P<n>-S<n>. Sub-steps append a lowercase letter suffix: P<n>-S<n>a.

progress-history-entry.description: Record of a single accepted step.

progress.description: Tracks which step is active and which steps have been accepted.

current.description: The step id that should be worked on right now, or 'complete' when all steps are done.

history.description: Ordered list of accepted steps, oldest first.

meta.description: Plan-level metadata, completion policy, and progress tracker.

plan-version.description: Semantic version of the plan document itself.

rm-revision.description: Revision number of the reference manual.

rm-last-modified.description: Year-month of the reference manual edition used (YYYY-MM).

target-spec.description: Repo-relative path to the family spec YAML that this plan populates.

schema.description: Repo-relative path to the family spec JSON schema.

page-corpus.description: Repo-relative directory containing the extracted reference-manual pages.

total-pages.description: Total number of extracted pages in the corpus.

step-completion-policy.description: Human-readable statement of the rule that applies to every step's final acceptance criterion (advancing progress.current).

step.description: A single atomic unit of work within a phase.

title.description: Short imperative title for the step.

description.description: Detailed explanation of what the step does and why.

source-pages.description: Extracted corpus page numbers that are the authoritative source for this step.

depends-on.description: Step ids that must be accepted before this step may be started.

acceptance-criteria.description: Ordered list of verifiable conditions that must all be true for the step to be accepted. The step-completion-policy adds an implicit final criterion.

concern.description: A specific ambiguity or risk in this step that requires developer judgement before or during implementation. Must not be used to record formal specification data.

note.description: Structured contextual information about this step. Must not express formal specification data.

phase.description: A named group of related atomic steps.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the phase.

description.description: Optional explanation of the phase's scope and intent.

open-concern.description: A concern that has been surfaced from an inline step and requires developer guidance.

step.description: The step id to which this concern belongs.

status.description: Resolution state of the concern. Defaults to 'open' when absent.

description.description: Explanation of the concern. Required when status is 'open' or absent.

resolved-by.description: Explanation of how and where the concern was resolved. Required when status is 'resolved'.
